Student life and boarding

A safe, disciplined place to live and grow together.

Residential life at Dodola supports healthy routines, strong friendships, and the independence students need to thrive.

Life on campus

The school community extends beyond the classroom.

Clear routines help students make the most of every day, while staff provide the practical and pastoral support that boarding life requires.

Dormitory facilities

Structured residence halls with dedicated wardens, supervised study halls, and 24/7 security oversight.

Dining and nutrition

Balanced meals served in the central cafeteria to support healthy, active, growing minds.

Sports and recreation

Football, volleyball, athletics, and physical fitness during scheduled recreation hours.

Clubs and STEM

Science clubs, robotics groups, debate, and peer mentoring beyond standard class hours.

A predictable rhythm

Good routines create room for ambition.

Morning

Prepared start, breakfast, and on-time lessons.

Afternoon

Lessons, sport, clubs, and time with peers.

Evening

Supervised study, dinner, and a settled night routine.
